docs.text: CoSMoS — PAGASA Operational Notes ¶ This site documents PAGASA-specific changes made to the CoSMoS source tree in this repository. It complements — but does not replace — the main Sphinx documentation in docs/source/ . Contents ¶ Page What it covers Overview & behaviour What "track-less per-member ensembles" are, why the change was needed, and exactly how CoSMoS behaves with a missing or empty .cyc file Change reference File-by-file description of every code change Running & verifying Required data layout, how to run, what to look for in cosmos.log , and known caveats Summary of the change (July 2026) ¶ Previously, running an ensemble in per-member meteo mode (one subfolder per ensemble member inside the meteo dataset's cycle folder) required every member — at minimum the deterministic member — to ship a <member>.cyc tropical-cyclone track file: a member subfolder without a .cyc was not even recognised as a member; a missing deterministic .cyc aborted the whole cycle via cosmos.stop() ; an empty .cyc crashed track parsing or silently produced no ensemble models at all. After the change, the .cyc track is optional . When it is missing, empty, or unparseable, CoSMoS runs the ensemble in a track-less mode: no spiderweb ( .spw ) files, no track cone, and every ensemble member is forced purely with its own gridded wind / pressure / precipitation data ( amu / amv / amp ). This is what you want for non-cyclone events (e.g. monsoon surges) or when the meteo provider does not ship track files. Nothing changes for runs that do have a usable track — the existing spiderweb + cone flow is untouched.

This is what you want for non-cyclone events (e.g. monsoon surges) or when the meteo provider does not ship track files. Nothing changes for runs that do have a usable track — the existing spiderweb + cone flow is untouched.

docs.text: Change reference ¶ File-by-file description of the July 2026 track-less ensemble change. All paths are relative to CoSMoS/src/cosmos/ . scenario.py ¶ Scenario.__init__ — new attribute: self.meteo_ensemble_has_track = False True only when the deterministic member has a usable (non-empty) .cyc file. When False , the per-member ensemble runs on gridded forcing only. Scenario.detect_meteo_ensemble_mode() — two changes: A subfolder now qualifies as an ensemble member when it contains <member>.cyc or gridded <member>*.nc files (previously .cyc was mandatory, so track-less datasets were never detected): python if os.path.exists(os.path.join(sub, entry + ".cyc")): members.append(entry) elif glob.glob(os.path.join(sub, entry + "*.nc")): members.append(entry) After the member list is built, the deterministic member's .cyc is checked ( exists and size > 0 ) to set meteo_ensemble_has_track . The detection log line now says with track or WITHOUT track (gridded forcing only) . meteo.py ¶ _collect_meteo_ensemble_deterministic() — the hard failure was replaced by a graceful fallback. Previously: if not os.path.exists(cyc_file): cosmos.stop(f"Deterministic track file not found: {cyc_file}") tc = TropicalCyclone(track_file=cyc_file, name=member) Now the track is loaded only when the file exists and is non-empty, inside a try/except , and is additionally rejected when it has fewer than 3 track points (the minimum setup_track_ensemble() accepts). On any of those conditions the function logs the reason, sets cosmos.scenario.meteo_ensemble_has_track = False and cosmos.tropical_cyclone = None , and returns after the gridded data has already been collected — so deterministic models still get their meteo forcing. No storm.spw / storm.cyc / track.geojson.js are written. main_loop.py ¶ The ensemble gate gained an elif branch: if cosmos.scenario.run_ensemble and cosmos.tropical_cyclone: # Make track ensemble (this also add 'new' ensemble models that fall within the cone) setup_track_ensemble() elif cosmos.scenario.run_ensemble and cosmos.scenario.meteo_ensemble_mode: # Per-member gridded ensemble without a usable track (.cyc # missing or empty): no spiderwebs, no cone. Ensemble copies # are made for all qualifying models and each member is # forced with its own gridded amu/amv. setup_meteo_ensemble_without_track() track_ensemble.py ¶ New public function setup_meteo_ensemble_without_track() — the track-less counterpart of setup_track_ensemble() . Skips TropicalCycloneEnsemble , spiderweb generation, and the cone; only creates the _ensemble model copies. ensemble_names and track_ensemble_nr_realizations were already set by detect_meteo_ensemble_mode() . New helper _add_ensemble_model_copies(cone) — the model-copy block was extracted from setup_track_ensemble() so both entry points share it. With a cone gdf, only models whose exterior intersects the cone qualify (unchanged behaviour); with cone=None every non-tide-only model of an ensemble type qualifies. Nesting renames ( *_ensemble suffixes), deterministic_name , get_nested_models() , and set_paths() are identical to before. _generate_per_member_ensemble() (the with-track per-member flow) is now robust to individual members with a missing or empty .cyc : they are skipped during both the .cyc staging step and the per-member spiderweb loop, with a warning logged. sfincs.py / hurrywave.py ¶ The ensemble spiderweb declaration is now conditional on a spiderweb actually existing (in track-less runs cosmos.scenario.meteo_spiderweb stays None ): # sfincs.py — was: if self.ensemble: if self.ensemble and self.meteo_spiderweb: self.domain.config.set("spwfile", "sfincs.spw") ... # hurrywave.py — was: if self.ensemble: if self.ensemble and self.meteo_spiderweb: self.domain.config.set("spwfile", "hurrywave.spw") Without this, the model binaries would abort looking for a nonexistent sfincs.spw / hurrywave.spw in each member folder. model.py ¶ Model.write_meteo_input_files() — in the per-member loop, the step that copies ensemble_<member>.spw into the member's job subfolder is skipped entirely when meteo_ensemble_has_track is False , instead of emitting a "spw not found" warning for every member of every model. What was deliberately not changed ¶ webviewer.py — already guarded with if cosmos.tropical_cyclone is not None and if cosmos.scenario.track_ensemble ; track/cone overlays are simply omitted. The S3 spiderweb upload in main_loop.py — already gated on cosmos.tropical_cyclone . run_sfincs.py / run_hurrywave.py cloud-mode spiderweb download — see the caveat on the Running & verifying page. config["spw_path"] in Model.write_config_yml() — still written for ensemble models; harmless (local runners do not read it).

docs.text: Running & verifying ¶ Required data layout ¶ Stage the ensemble data in the meteo database exactly as before, minus the .cyc files (or with empty ones — both work): <meteo_db>/<dataset>/<YYYYMMDD_HHz>/ <member_01>/ <member_01>.20260706_0000.nc <member_01>.20260706_0600.nc ... <member_02>/ ... Requirements: The scenario must have run_ensemble = true and point meteo_dataset at this dataset. Member folder names must prefix their .nc files ( <member>*.nc ) — that prefix is now the detection signature when no .cyc is present. config.run.event_mode must be "meteo" (the default storm/weather flow). Per-member data is assumed pre-staged: download_meteo() skips per-member datasets, unchanged. Then run as usual: python -m cosmos run <scenario_name> --path <run_folder> --cycle <YYYYMMDD_HHz> What to look for in cosmos.log ¶ A healthy track-less run logs, in order: Per-member meteo ensemble detected WITHOUT track (gridded forcing only): N members (...); deterministic = <member> Collecting meteo data (per-member, deterministic=<member>) : <dataset> No (usable) deterministic track file found: <path>/<member>.cyc Per-member ensemble will run on gridded forcing only (no spiderwebs, no track cone). Setting up per-member meteo ensemble without cyclone track (N members) ... Meteo ensemble (no track) done ... If the deterministic .cyc exists but is empty or broken you will instead see one of: Deterministic track file <path> has fewer than 3 track points — ignoring track. Could not read deterministic track file <path> (<error>) — ignoring track. followed by the same "gridded forcing only" lines. During pre-processing, each ensemble model logs one line per member as its forcing cut-out is written: meteo forcing files for ensemble member <member> ... Quick checklist after pre-processing ¶ Each _ensemble model's job folder contains one subfolder per member with sfincs_wind.nc (or hurrywave_wind.nc , amu / amv / amp ) inside. No sfincs.spw / hurrywave.spw in the member folders, and no spwfile line in sfincs.inp / hurrywave.inp . <cycle>/track/ in the scenario cycle folder is absent or empty (no storm.spw / storm.cyc ). The web viewer builds without a track or cone overlay. Caveats ¶ Mixed tracks If the deterministic (last-sorted) member has a usable track but other members do not, the run uses the normal spiderweb flow and the track-less members are skipped during spiderweb generation with a warning. Those member simulations will then fail, because the shared model input declares a spwfile the member folder does not have. Keep tracks all-or-nothing per cycle, or ask for the per-member fallback to be implemented. Cloud run mode run_sfincs.py / run_hurrywave.py unconditionally download the member spiderweb from S3 when run_mode = "cloud" and the model is an ensemble member. Track-less ensembles have no spiderwebs on S3, so cloud mode is not yet supported for track-less runs . Local serial / parallel modes are fine. Deterministic models Deterministic (non-ensemble) models are unaffected: they are forced by the deterministic member's gridded data, which is still collected before the track check. They previously also received storm.spw on top of the gridded forcing; in track-less runs that extra spiderweb layer simply does not exist.

docs.text: Track-less per-member ensembles — overview & behaviour ¶ Background: per-member meteo ensemble mode ¶ CoSMoS detects a per-member meteo ensemble when the meteo dataset's cycle folder contains one subfolder per ensemble member: <meteo_db>/<dataset>/<YYYYMMDD_HHz>/ <member_A>/ <member_A>.cyc # member's cyclone track (now OPTIONAL) <member_A>.YYYYMMDD_HHMM.nc ... # member's gridded forcing <member_B>/ ... Detection happens in Scenario.detect_meteo_ensemble_mode() (called from the main loop, before meteo download/collect). When members are found: scenario.meteo_ensemble_mode = True scenario.ensemble_names = the sorted member folder names the last (sorted) member acts as the deterministic representative scenario.track_ensemble_nr_realizations = number of members With a usable track, the flow then builds storm.spw for the deterministic member, a per-member ensemble_<member>.spw from each member's gridded wind field, and a track cone that decides which models get _ensemble copies. What the .cyc file was needed for ¶ Consumer Role of the track detect_meteo_ensemble_mode() <member>.cyc was the signature that marked a folder as an ensemble member _collect_meteo_ensemble_deterministic() (meteo.py) Loaded the deterministic member's .cyc ; aborted the run ( cosmos.stop ) if absent; wrote storm.spw / storm.cyc / track.geojson.js setup_track_ensemble() (track_ensemble.py) Built the TropicalCycloneEnsemble , wrote per-member spiderwebs, and computed the cone used to select which models get ensemble copies SFINCS / HurryWave wrappers Pointed the ensemble model input at sfincs.spw / hurrywave.spw Web viewer Track and cone overlays (already guarded — skipped when absent) New behaviour matrix ¶ The deterministic member is the last sorted member; its .cyc decides the mode of the whole run. Deterministic member's .cyc Behaviour Present, parseable, ≥ 3 track points Unchanged. Spiderwebs + cone flow as before. Missing Track-less mode (was: fatal cosmos.stop ). Present but empty (0 bytes) Track-less mode (was: parse crash). Present but unparseable, or < 3 track points Track-less mode , with the reason logged (was: crash or silent no-ensemble). In track-less mode : Member folders are recognised by their gridded <member>*.nc files alone — no .cyc needed. A new scenario flag meteo_ensemble_has_track is set to False . collect_meteo() still collects the deterministic member's gridded data (deterministic models run normally, forced by netcdf wind/pressure), but writes no storm.spw / storm.cyc , and leaves cosmos.tropical_cyclone = None . Instead of setup_track_ensemble() , the main loop calls the new setup_meteo_ensemble_without_track() : every non-tide-only model whose type is listed in ensemble_models gets an _ensemble copy — there is no cone to intersect with, so no spatial filtering. Each ensemble member is forced purely with its own gridded data: the existing per-member loop in Model.write_meteo_input_files() re-collects that member's grids and writes the forcing cut-out into <job>/<member>/ . The spiderweb staging step is skipped. The SFINCS / HurryWave input files do not declare a spwfile , so the binaries never look for a spiderweb that does not exist. The web viewer simply omits the track and cone overlays (existing guards). Mixed case: only some members have a usable track ¶ If the deterministic member has a good track but other members have a missing/empty .cyc , the run stays in the normal with-track flow, and the affected members are skipped during spiderweb generation with a logged warning: warning: no usable track for ensemble member <name> — skipping its spiderweb (gridded forcing only). Warning In this mixed case the ensemble model's input file still declares spwfile (because the run as a whole has spiderwebs), so a member without one will fail at the model binary. Watch for the warning above and either fix that member's .cyc or delete it from the cycle folder. Making this fall back gracefully per member is a possible follow-up.
